description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, 2026-10-24), YAML-PP census.  SILENT WRONG then a die, PRE-EXISTING.

    use Scalar::Util qw(reftype);
    our $var = "Hola"; our @var = (3,14);
    my $value; my $r = \$value; $$r = *{"main::var"}; print reftype($r), "\n";        # GLOB both (right)
    my $v2; my $o = bless \$v2, "Foo"; $$o = *{"main::var"};
    print reftype($o), " ", ref($o), "\n";            # perl GLOB Foo     PCL REF Foo
    my $gg = *{$o}; print "name=$gg\n";               # perl *main::var   PCL *main::Foo=GLOB(0x1)
    my $ar = *{$o}{ARRAY}; print "arr=@$ar\n";        # perl 3 14         PCL (empty)
Reproducer scratch/s526w2/g2.pl.  YAML::PP::Schema::Perl does exactly this (`$self->object(\$value, $class)` then `$$$ref = $self->construct_glob($list)`).  Neighbours: #3674 (*FH{IO} reftype), #3552 (a blessed glob returned from a sub loses its class).
Rows: YAML-PP 54.glob.t valid + *PLAN* (perl 3, PCL 1; the file then dies "Can't use an undefined value as an ARRAY reference").

=== DONE (s530c) ===
FIXED, runtime only (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp), two readers of one fact -- "the referent scalar holds a glob VALUE, so it is a GV":
 * p-reftype's BLESSED arm now asks `%p-glob-value-box-p` of the referent (`%p-ref-referent`) before its SCALAR/REF split -- p-ref's own arm for the unblessed spelling, so the two spellings answer GLOB alike.
 * p-dynamic-typeglob (`*{EXPR}`) takes a scalar REFERENCE whose referent holds a typeglob (`%p-scalar-ref-referent`) to that glob; it used to stringify the reference (`Foo=GLOB(0x1)`) and read it back as a glob NAME, so `*{$o}` was `*main::Foo=GLOB(0x1)` and `*{$o}{ARRAY}` empty.
Probe scratch/s530c/pr/gl1.pl (7 rows: reftype unblessed/blessed, bless of a ref to a scalar that ALREADY holds a glob, the glob's name, *{$o}{ARRAY}, ${*{$o}{SCALAR}}, the ref's stringification) -- all identical to perl (5 wrong before).  Guard Pl/t/bless-referent-01.t t16 (inverse: fails on ff265320).
YAML-PP-v0.39.0 t/54.glob.t one-file run: subtest `valid` passes (4/4 inner rows) -- its row left baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit; the file then stops on a NEWLY EXPOSED cause, filed #4104 (Can't locate object method "descend" via package "main", Test::Deep), and the *PLAN* row was re-attributed to it.
subject: A BLESSED ref to a scalar that later receives a GLOB answers reftype REF (perl GLOB), stringifies the glob as the ref ("*main::Foo=GLOB(0x1)" for *{$o}) and *{$o}{ARRAY} is empty -- the unblessed spelling is right (YAML::PP glob loading, 54.glob.t)
